title.zh: 数字人技术路线：从人像驱动到可复现交付
title.en: Digital human pipelines: from portrait driving to reviewable delivery

summary.zh: 区分肖像动作迁移、音频口型驱动与实时三维角色，梳理输入、生成、检查和授权边界。
summary.en: Separate portrait motion transfer, audio-driven lip sync and real-time 3D avatars; follow their inputs, generation steps, quality checks and consent boundaries.

basis.zh: 依据 LivePortrait、MuseTalk 等公开项目文档及相关论文整理为学习指南。本文没有在本机执行这些模型，也不表示它们已集成到个人项目；实际参数和依赖以所选版本的上游说明为准。
basis.en: A study guide based on public project documentation and papers for LivePortrait, MuseTalk and related work. These models were not run locally for this note and are not claimed as integrations in the listed projects; follow the upstream documentation for the exact release you select.

paragraphs.zh: “数字人”不是单一模型。肖像动作迁移通常从一张身份图像和一段驱动视频出发，把姿态、表情和头部运动迁移到目标肖像；LivePortrait 属于这一路线。音频驱动口型以语音为条件生成或调整唇部运动，MuseTalk 等项目聚焦视听同步。实时三维角色则把骨骼、面部 blendshape、语音或动作控制器交给三维引擎，重点是低延迟、连续控制和场景渲染。
paragraphs.en: “Digital human” is not one model. Portrait motion transfer starts from an identity image and a driving video, then transfers pose, expression and head motion; LivePortrait is an example. Audio-driven lip sync conditions mouth motion on speech; projects such as MuseTalk focus on audio-visual synchronization. A real-time 3D avatar instead combines a rig, facial blendshapes, speech or motion controls and a 3D engine, emphasizing latency, continuous control and scene rendering.

paragraphs.zh: 这几类方法解决的问题不同：仅有一张照片和一段语音时，动作迁移模型缺少驱动视频中的动作；仅有驱动视频时，口型也不会自动与新语音同步。选型前先写清输入、输出、是否实时、可接受的身份变化和授权范围。
paragraphs.en: These methods solve different problems. A portrait-motion model does not get motion from speech alone if it expects a driving video; a driving video does not automatically acquire lip sync for a new voice. Before choosing a model, specify inputs, outputs, real-time needs, acceptable identity changes and permissions.

title.zh: 02 / 从素材到成片的处理链
title.en: 02 / The path from source media to an output

paragraphs.zh: 典型肖像动画流程包含人脸检测与裁剪、身份外观编码、驱动姿态/表情提取、运动映射、图像生成或重绘，以及边界融合和视频编码。口型路线还要对齐音频片段、音素或视听特征与视频帧。渲染出一段视频只是推理结果，不等于已经验证身份保持、唇形同步、跨场景稳健性或真实感。
paragraphs.en: A typical portrait-animation pipeline detects and crops a face, encodes identity appearance, extracts pose and expression from the driver, maps motion, synthesizes or reenacts frames, blends boundaries and encodes video. A lip-sync route also aligns audio segments, phonemes or audio-visual features with video frames. Rendering a clip is an inference result; it does not by itself validate identity preservation, lip-sync quality, robustness across scenes or realism.

bullets.zh: 肖像动作迁移：身份图像 + 驱动视频 → 动作提取与映射 → 合成视频。
bullets.en: Portrait motion transfer: identity image + driving video → motion extraction and mapping → synthesized video.

bullets.zh: 音频口型同步：授权肖像视频 + 语音 → 口型/视听同步生成 → 同步视频。
bullets.en: Audio-driven lip sync: authorized portrait video + speech → lip-motion or audio-visual synthesis → synchronized video.

bullets.zh: 实时三维角色：角色绑定 + 动作/语音控制 → 实时引擎渲染 → 可交互画面。
bullets.en: Real-time 3D avatar: rigged character + motion or speech controls → real-time engine rendering → interactive scene.

title.zh: 03 / 可复做的肖像动作迁移练习

paragraphs.zh: 以下以 LivePortrait 上游快速示例为练习入口：选定一个 release 或 commit，先阅读该版本 README 和权重许可；安装 CUDA/PyTorch 时以本机显卡与官方安装说明配套。命令中的示例素材来自上游仓库，不要把他人肖像或未经许可的视频替换进去。此步骤指南没有在本机执行验证。
paragraphs.en: The upstream LivePortrait quick-start is used here as a learning entry point. Select a release or commit and read its README and checkpoint terms first; match CUDA and PyTorch to the local GPU using the official installation guidance. The command uses the repository's sample assets; do not substitute another person's portrait or an unlicensed video. This procedure has not been executed locally for this note.

code.text:
# Create an isolated environment, then follow the selected upstream release notes.
conda create -n portrait-lab python=3.10 -y
conda activate portrait-lab
git clone https://github.com/KwaiVGI/LivePortrait.git
cd LivePortrait
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# Download model checkpoints only from the official instructions.
# This quick-start uses the repository's own sample image and driving video.
python inference.py -s assets/examples/source/s9.jpg -d assets/examples/driving/d0.mp4

callout.zh: 环境版本、显卡支持和命令行参数会随上游版本变化。遇到参数不匹配时，以固定版本 README 为准，不要把模型权重、访问令牌或私人素材提交到公开仓库。
callout.en: Environment versions, GPU support and command-line options can change upstream. If an option differs, follow the README for the pinned release. Never commit model weights, access tokens or private media to a public repository.

paragraphs.zh: 先从全片抽取开头、中段、转场和结尾帧，检查裁切跳变、头部漂移、遮挡边缘、牙齿/眼睛变形和背景闪烁；口型任务额外核对音频与嘴部开合的时间偏差。再用同一组素材和设置比较版本，把失败案例也保留下来。人工检查适合作为初筛；若要报告研究结论，还需预先定义数据划分、评价指标、基线和统计不确定性。
paragraphs.en: Sample frames from the start, middle, transitions and end of the clip. Inspect crop jumps, head drift, occlusion boundaries, distorted teeth or eyes and background flicker; for lip-sync, also check timing between audio and mouth opening. Compare versions with the same source media and settings, and retain failure cases. Human review is a useful first pass; research claims additionally need predefined splits, metrics, baselines and statistical uncertainty.

bullets.zh: 输入质量：人脸是否清晰、无遮挡，驱动素材是否稳定，音画是否正确对齐。
bullets.en: Input quality: Is the face clear and unobstructed? Is the driver stable? Are audio and video aligned?

bullets.zh: 输出质量：身份是否漂移、表情是否自然、边界是否闪烁、声音与口型是否同步。
bullets.en: Output quality: Does identity drift? Are expressions natural? Do boundaries flicker? Are speech and lip motion synchronized?

bullets.zh: 实验记录：模型版本、权重来源、输入摘要、参数、随机种子、运行环境与失败说明。
bullets.en: Experiment record: model version, checkpoint source, input summary, parameters, random seed, runtime environment and failure notes.

callout.zh: 研究演示必须使用本人或取得明确授权的肖像、声音与驱动视频，并说明合成属性。涉及真实人物时，不要通过克隆声音或拟真形象制造未披露的背书、冒充或误导。
callout.en: Use your own media or obtain explicit permission for every portrait, voice and driving video, and disclose synthetic output. With real people, do not use cloned voices or realistic likenesses for undisclosed endorsements, impersonation or deception.
